name: Iridic-Antiphon
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, an orbital debris ring emerge like the bones of the planet.

Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Slow groves of photosynthetic columns migrate centimeters a season toward the light.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
